disclosureQuote: As of October 1, 2026 Our previous disclaimer disclosed the use of AI in drafting some of our original assets. As of October 1, 2026, thanks to the support of our early backers, the use of Aseprite and GIMP, and the work of talented freelance artists, all assets have been redrawn, rebuilt, and redesigned from their original versions, allowing us to move away from AI-generated artwork. We will retain this disclaimer in the interest of complete transparency and to acknowledge the development process behind the game.

summary: 恶魔猎杀题材的割草动作游戏，2026 年 10 月 26 日上架，cbgames 开发、Sojaplin Studios 发行，支持最多 3 人联机，分类为动作／休闲／独立。商店 AI 披露说明此前的披露曾承认用 AI 起草部分原始资产，并写明自 2026 年 10 月 1 日起所有素材已经重绘、重建与重新设计，摆脱了 AI 生成美术，开发者表示会保留这条披露以保持透明。本站据此把美术登记为已使用（开发早期确有 AI 参与），把替换完成的说法保留为开发者自述，其余七个领域登记为未说明。所有结论只有开发者自述支撑，未经独立审计。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 cbgames，发行商 Sojaplin Studios）与英文讨论区首页（可见 8 个主题，总数 8，即首页覆盖全部主题）；首页没有命中 AI 关键词的主题，因此没有相关帖可读。本款检索公开报道 2 次，登记所采用那次响应的 6 条结果，0 条被判定为相关、没有读取任何第三方来源：结果分别是 r/MegabonkOfficial 的试玩版公告讨论帖、本作商店页的两条链接、一条与本作无关且需登录的 Instagram 帖子、genplay.gg 的站点列表页（未含本作条目正文）与 gameaicheck.com 的反作弊清单页，均无本作披露原文或不可逐字核验；coverageLimits 另写明本作只有商店页与试玩版讨论帖命中、聚合站未收录该作条目。检索没有命中不代表本作没有使用 AI。本站把美术登记为已使用的依据是开发者对早期版本的自述，其重绘替换完成的说法同样是开发者自述，未经独立审计，也没有逐资产核验。
description: 扮演杀进地狱潮的机器：撕开成群敌人、叠加夸张到失控的强化、搭配崩坏边缘的 build，单人或最多三人联机推进。

english.summary: A demon-slaying horde action game released on Oct 26, 2026, developed by cbgames and published by Sojaplin Studios, with online co-op for up to four players and filed under Action, Casual and Indie. The Steam AI disclosure records that an earlier disclaimer disclosed the use of AI in drafting some original assets, and that as of Oct 1, 2026 every asset has been redrawn, rebuilt and redesigned so the game moved away from AI-generated artwork, with the disclaimer kept for transparency. This site records art as used on the disclosed early involvement of AI and reports the replacement as the developer own statement, with the other seven areas unaddressed. Every finding rests on the developer own statement and none of it has been independently audited.
english.reviewNote: Checked the complete English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer cbgames, publisher Sojaplin Studios) and the English discussion homepage (8 visible topics of 8, so the homepage covers every topic), where no topic matches the AI keyword search, so no thread needed reading. This title was searched twice and the disposition covers the 6 results of the response used; none was judged relevant, so no third-party source was read. The results were the demo announcement thread in r/MegabonkOfficial, two links to the store page of this game, an Instagram post unrelated to this title and behind a login, the site-level listing page of genplay.gg without an entry body for this game and the anti-cheat listing page of gameaicheck.com; none carries this games disclosure text or can be quoted verbatim, and coverageLimits records that only the store page and the demo thread matched while the aggregators hold no entry for this title. An empty search result is not proof that AI was not used. The art finding rests on the developer statement about the earlier version, and the completed replacement is also a developer statement that has not been independently audited or verified asset by asset.
